terms.grammar: verb, third conjugation (-iō): aliquid alicui reī or ad aliquid
evidence: Hor. Ep. 2.2.43: adjēcēre bonae paulō plūs artis Athēnae (Lewis & Short s.v. adjiciō)
terms.comment: “Throw to”: something added on top of what is there; addō is the plain word.

phrases.latin: Prīmum aquam īnfunde; deinde folia adde.
phrases.english: Pour in the water first; then add the leaves.

sources: The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 28, checked against the searchable text of the book.
